baseline_models.mechanism: The clause tracks one complete displacement: a force extracts humans from emplacement, and the simile names the resulting rear or trunk-like remains after separation from the root-base.

activation_trace.role: Pulling a thing from its emplacement supplies the governing action: the people are removed, not merely struck.
Visible human beings supply the living collective whose condition the action transforms.
The rear or end of a thing supplies the trunk-like remainder exposed after removal.
The palm supplies the upright rooted body used to render the human aftermath.
Uprooting from the origin supplies the completed result and closes the extraction path.

changed_reading.before: People are violently blown down and look like fallen palms.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages total loss of emplacement: living persons are extracted and rendered as the rear or trunk remains of palms torn from their root-base.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَنزِعُ الناس followed by the inanimate palm-remnant simile
baseline_models.mechanism: A death-throe branch of نزع makes the line a transition in state as well as location: those seized are named as people, but the completed image presents only uprooted structural remains.

activation_trace.role: The death-agony sense makes extraction terminal rather than merely spatial.
Human identity marks the animate state at the instant of seizure.
Rear portions or ends supply the depersonalized state left after the transition.
Palm trunks provide the inanimate structural likeness of the human remains.
Removal from the root supplies irreversible completion.

changed_reading.after: The extraction is also a terminal passage: they enter the verb as people and emerge from the simile as uprooted, object-like remains.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الناس as human presence set against collective نخل
baseline_models.mechanism: The social-presence branch behind الناس and the collective range of نخل allow the event to scale from bodies to habitation: a place loses the company that made it human as completely as ground loses an uprooted grove.

activation_trace.role: Extraction from emplacement supplies removal of a population from its setting.
Companionship that removes desolation supplies the human presence lost from the place.
Palm as both tree and collective supplies a grove-scale analogue for the human collective.
Uprooting from origin makes the loss of presence total rather than temporary.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes what happens to many individual bodies.
changed_reading.after: It also images depopulation: human familiarity is pulled out of a place as completely as a grove is torn from its ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah resolves the unnamed force as a dispatched wind. The focus therefore becomes directed extraction by an assigned medium, not an unowned tableau of fallen bodies.

activation_trace.role: Extraction from emplacement names the task performed by the carried-over agent.
Sending and impelling supplies directed deployment of the force.
Wind and moving air identify the physical agent inherited by تَنزِعُ.
Uprooting from origin identifies the dispatched agent's completed work.

structural_cues: 54:19 immediately precedes the focus and supplies a feminine singular wind; تَنزِعُ is likewise feminine singular.
عَلَيْهِمْ gives the dispatched force a human target before الناس names that target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sent wind and the focus supplies extraction; I carry ريح forward as the verb's subject and read dispatch as directed agency. A live alternative is simple grammatical continuation without added intentional-mechanical emphasis.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified force leaves people resembling uprooted palms.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately dispatched wind executes extraction, pulling people from emplacement until the palm-root result is complete.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wind chain activates the نزع branch of direction-changing winds. Read mechanically, cold noisy gusts act on competing vectors, while the twisted-rope branch of مرر supplies a torsional analogy: attachments are worked until they shear at the base.

activation_trace.role: Winds from differing directions supply the cross-vector motion latent inside the extraction verb.
Moving air supplies the material carrier of the cross-directional force.
The cold ṣarṣar wind supplies the severe gust regime rather than a neutral breeze.
Tightly twisting a rope supplies a secondary torsion image for how repeated gusts work an attachment.
Separation from the root is the predicted failure point of the torsional mechanism.

structural_cues: The wind's adjective chain stands immediately before the extraction clause.
The palm simile gives the directional force a visible base-failure result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wind, cold severity, twisting, and a نزع crosswind branch; I supply the shear-and-torsion arrow connecting them to uprooting. The materially live alternative is that مُّسْتَمِرٍّ denotes duration only.

changed_reading.before: A strong wind pushes or lifts people away.
changed_reading.after: Direction-changing gusts twist and shear people from their supports, making the uprooted-palm comparison a compact account of force geometry.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warnings bracket the bodily image and remembrance follows it. The conspicuous configuration of uprooted trunk-remains therefore functions not only as aftermath but as a retained visual warning meant to reactivate caution.

activation_trace.role: Rear or terminal remains supply the visible object that can persist after the event.
Complete uprooting makes the aftermath unmistakable enough to carry warning force.
Warning that awakens caution opens the frame in which the bodily image is read.
The repeated warning closes the physical scene and assigns cautionary force to its result.
A reminder as that which makes one remember turns the retained image into a mnemonic.

structural_cues: The same punishment-and-warning question occurs on both sides of the focus scene.
The remembrance refrain follows immediately after the closing warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the warning bracket and call to remembrance; I infer that the scene's exact visual form is selected for mnemonic persistence. The live alternative is that these refrains frame the event rhetorically without making the remains a sign-object.

changed_reading.before: The palm comparison intensifies the horror of the casualties.
changed_reading.after: The uprooted forms are also made readable: a durable visual warning positioned to be recalled after the destructive instant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later عقر scene rotates the three radicals of focus قعر and converges with it at the level of support. Hamstringing an animal and uprooting a palm both disable an upright living body by destroying its attachment at the base.

activation_trace.role: Uprooting from the origin supplies the focus scene's base-severing result.
The rear or lower remainder locates attention at the failed support end.
Hamstringing the animal supplies a second destruction enacted at load-bearing limbs.
The origin or base sense makes the shared support locus explicit.

structural_cues: ق ع ر in مُّنقَعِرٍ and ع ق ر in عَقَرَ rotate the same three radicals across adjacent destruction accounts.
Both scenes end with a formerly upright living body disabled at its ground-contact support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uprooting, hamstringing, and origin branches; I infer a cross-scene analogy in which destroying support converts vertical life into inert remainder. The live alternative is lexical coincidence between two independent ordinary senses.

changed_reading.before: The palm image describes the shape of bodies after a storm.
changed_reading.after: The image isolates a repeated failure mechanism: life organized upright is defeated by severing the support through which it stands.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later vegetal simile supplies another terminal material state. Uprooted palm rears and broken dry enclosure matter form a repeated grammar of dismantling: rooted organism becomes separated remainder, then plant structure becomes fragment within a failed boundary.

activation_trace.role: The palm supplies an intact but uprooted vegetal structure at the focus stage.
Rear or terminal portions supply the first state of separated remainder.
Breaking and crushing supplies the later transition from structural remainder to fragments.
Dry broken vegetation supplies the material analogue that echoes the focus palm.
An enclosure that gathers and blocks supplies the boundary whose contents have become debris.

structural_cues: Both destruction scenes conclude with a vegetal comparison after a sent force.
The focus preserves trunk-scale remains; 54:31 reduces bounded plant material to broken matter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two distinct vegetal aftermaths; I arrange them as a conceptual degradation sequence, not as the chronology of one set of victims. The live alternative is that the similes are independent images with no staged material relation.

changed_reading.before: The uprooted palm is a single local comparison for bodily appearance.
changed_reading.after: It is the first of two vegetal aftermaths that expose social and bodily structure by progressively dismantling it into remainder and debris.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bow image is surprising because تَنزِعُ directly governs people and extraction is dominant; it remains branch-anchored through bowstring drawing and the immediately preceding dispatch language. Render it only as a secondary tension-and-release overlay, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَنزِعُ, with the people ending as displaced palm remains

activation_trace.role: Drawing a bowstring supplies stored tension inside the extraction verb.
Sending or releasing supplies the complementary discharge phase.
Uprooted displacement supplies the visible result after tension is discharged.

changed_reading.before: The wind simply pulls people from the ground.
changed_reading.after: As a contained mechanical echo, the force loads bodies under tension and releases them into displaced, uprooted remains.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The sifting image is branch-distant because نَخْلٍ plainly denotes palms; it remains anchored in the same root's filtering branch and is activated by the later allocation of water shares. Downstream prose should preserve it only as a faint material analogy beneath the explicit botanical simile.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَخْلٍ within a clause of extraction and remaining ends

activation_trace.role: Sifting flour supplies separation of a mass into removed and residual material.
Extraction supplies the removal operation within the sifting analogy.
Ends or remainders supply what the destructive separation leaves visible.
Dividing a thing into allotted shares activates separation as an ordered operation.
An apportioned water share gives the later division a concrete material object.

changed_reading.before: Palm is exclusively the botanical object of comparison.
changed_reading.after: Beneath the palm image, catastrophe faintly resembles sifting: people are extracted from a collective mass and terminal remainders are left exposed.

strongest_changes: 54:19 identifies a dispatched wind as the subject, turning the focus from an unowned tableau into directed extraction.
The ن ز ع crosswind branch plus the preceding wind chain yields a torsional uprooting mechanism.
The ق ع ر / ع ق ر echo links uprooted palms to severed animal supports, making loss of base the repeated mechanism.
summary.what_was_special: The distinctive activation was mechanical: direction-changing wind, removal from emplacement, and rotated root language converged on destruction of support; the warning-remembrance frame then made the remains readable.
remaining_uncertainties: مُّسْتَمِرٍّ most directly marks duration; its twisted-rope branch is only an exploratory mechanical overlay.
The ق ع ر / ع ق ر relation may be deliberate sound-patterning or a reader-detected analogy.
The bow and sieve readings are branch-licensed secondary images, not replacements for the explicit palm simile.
